identity.individuality_rule: Two Volb of the same species are not required to share personality, temperament, affection style, social behavior, preferences, fears, habits, or reactions.

personality.behavior_rule: Personality rolls change how this individual Volb expresses an intent. They do not change the underlying biological need.

preference_discovery.discovery_rule: Repeated experiences gradually establish the individual Volb's preferences rather than assigning universal species favorites.

care_willingness.rule: High bond can increase trust and willingness, but does not force an individual Volb to become cheerful, social, affectionate, energetic, or obedient.

progression.base_stats_reference: Live starter-species.ts remains authoritative; preserve existing egg.base_stats. Profile HP/ATK/MAGI/DEF/SPD/Mana = 1/5/0/0/4/0; live registry = 1/1/3/0/4/1. Reconciliation undecided.

player_skill_decisions.replacement_semantics: Future approved milestones only: reuse existing animation timing, show four eligible names/descriptions, select and confirm exactly one. Confirm the specific old skill before atomic replacement when authoritative learned capacity permits. Four local equipped slots do not establish learned capacity. Validate ownership, eligibility and idempotency; prevent duplicate learning/rewards. Cancellation or failure preserves existing skills. No UI or persistence activated.
